steps.title: Establish Project Identity
steps.description: Defined dynamic package metadata: com.moderncalculator.app and app name: Modern Calculator.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up app/build.gradle with Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2, compile/target SDK 34, min SDK 21, and explicit Java 8 targets to ensure stable building.

steps.title: Declare App Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Generated AndroidManifest.xml declaring the launch activity, custom theme, custom icon resource, and default permissions.

steps.title: Define Modern UI Color Palette
steps.description: Configured modern color tokens including deep indigo, bright coral red, fresh emerald, and soft backgrounds for dynamic design layouts.

steps.title: Configure App Localization & Strings
steps.description: Added localized UI labels, dynamic history layout headings, button tags, and utility strings in strings.xml.

steps.title: Design Numeric Button Style
steps.description: Created premium ripple layout for numeric keys with subtle rounded corners and standard light grey/white background.

steps.title: Design Operator Button Style
steps.description: Designed high-contrast, premium dark indigo button drawables to represent primary math operators.

steps.title: Design Equal Button Style
steps.description: Created interactive emerald green button shape drawables for the core calculation activation state.

steps.title: Design Utility and Clear Buttons Style
steps.description: Structured modern custom red-coral gradient background styles for primary clear/all-clear buttons.

steps.title: Design Display and Layout Panels
steps.description: Engineered custom rounded corner panel drawables for the calculator display screen and the history tray card.

steps.title: Create User Interface Layout
steps.description: Built interactive, modern, and adaptive UI inside activity_main.xml featuring dynamic display fields, calculation history drawer, and a structured, ergonomic keypad.

steps.title: Implement High-Performance Expression Parser
steps.description: Created a lightweight mathematical expression parser utilizing recursive descent to process nested parenthesis, decimal arithmetic, percentage, and operator precedence safely.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic History Logic
steps.description: Programmed an inline history recorder and sliding overlay view that keeps track of past inputs and lets users tap a item to restore previous expressions.

steps.title: Implement Smart Keyboard Input Rules
steps.description: Wrote intelligent helper algorithms to handle nested parenthesization, preventing multiple decimal points in a single term, and managing zero divisions cleanly.

steps.title: Validate Namespace and Attribute Configurations
steps.description: Performed absolute verification of standard manifest schemes, layout resource bindings, and target API parameters.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Trigger local gradle compiler wrapper to generate and output clean executable native Android debug binaries.
